title: User-Adaptive Fusion of Multiple Foundation Models for Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.31951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can recommender systems benefit from combining a collection of foundation models within and across modalities? While different foundation models may capture complementary aspects of item metadata, we find that naively combining their representations yields only marginal gains over using a single foundation model. We make a key observation: the users who benefit vary across foundation models. Motivated by this observation, we introduce UF2O, a user-adaptive approach for fusing multiple foundation models for recommendation. In a nutshell, UF2O models the contribution of each foundation model as user-specific by maintaining separate recommendation views and adaptively combining their scores for each user. By performing fusion at the score level, UF2O can also fuse heterogeneous foundation models without directly aligning their representation spaces. translated_title: 面向推荐系统的用户自适应多基础模型融合
translated_abstract: 推荐系统能否通过融合多个基础模型（模态内及跨模态）而受益？虽然不同的基础模型可能捕捉到物品元数据中互补的不同方面，但我们发现，简单地将它们的表示组合起来，相比仅使用单个基础模型只能带来微弱的提升。我们提出了一个关键观察：受益于不同基础模型的用户群体是各不相同的。受此启发，我们提出了UF2O，一种面向推荐的用户自适应多基础模型融合方法。简而言之，UF2O通过为每个基础模型维护独立的推荐视图，并自适应地为每个用户组合各模型的得分，从而将每个基础模型的贡献建模为用户特定的。由于在得分层面进行融合，UF2O还能够融合异构的基础模型，而无需直接对齐它们的表示空间。在四个数据集上联合融合四个基础模型的大量实验表明，UF2O相比单一基础模型和朴素融合方法取得了显著的性能提升。
tldr: 本文提出用户自适应融合方法UF2O，通过在得分层面为每个用户自适应地组合多个基础模型的推荐得分，无需对齐表示空间即可融合异构基础模型，从而显著提升推荐效果。
en_tdlr: UF2O is a user-adaptive fusion approach that adaptively combines the scores of multiple foundation models for each user at the score level, enabling the fusion of heterogeneous foundation models without aligning their representation spaces and yielding significant recommendation improvements.
